about:
Johnson Furniture Manufacturing Company operates from Conway, South Carolina, where it was founded in 1947 by Grier Johnson Sr. to build furniture for local homeowners. The business remains family-owned across three generations: Grier Johnson Jr. took leadership in 1970, and his children Tracy, Jess, and Norton joined in the 1990s. After a brief period with manufacturing in the Myrtle Beach area, production returned to Conway in 2006.

The company manufactures commercial-grade upholstery, case goods, and drapery collections at its Conway facility. Its product lines are built with commercial components designed to withstand heavy use in coastal rental environments. All items are made in the United States, and the company emphasizes quick production and delivery cycles to keep vacation rental properties operational.

Primary customers are vacation rental property owners, condo owners, and the hotel and motel operators along the Grand Strand. The shift to hospitality-focused furniture followed the post-Hurricane Hazel building boom in 1954, which created a new clientele of beachside lodging businesses. Today the company supplies furniture directly to those operators and to individual condo owners through its sister retail brand, A Summer Home Inc., which maintains a Myrtle Beach showroom.

The founding mission was to serve local homeowners; the pivot to commercial furniture was driven by the need for pieces that could endure constant guest turnover. The company positions itself as a direct-from-manufacturer source, offering complimentary fabric samples and free local delivery and setup to simplify procurement for remote property owners.
